blocks.text: Pay&Go is expanding its nationwide network with new kiosks at selected locations of Watsons, The Generics Pharmacy (TGP), Premium Bikes, and Novo in Metro Manila; Gaisano in Cagayan de Oro; and Cecile’s Pharmacy in the Zamboanga Peninsula. The expansion creates more access points for customers to complete essential financial transactions in establishments they already know and trust. Through Pay&Go kiosks, customers can cash in, cash out, make bank deposits and withdrawal, pay bills, purchase e-load, top up toll cards, and access other services while visiting familiar community destinations.
